name: lodash-clone-isdeep-istex-api-faker
behavioral_change: lodash 4.0.0 removed the `isDeep` parameter of `_.clone`; deep cloning is now provided by `_.cloneDeep`. In v_new, `_.clone(x, true)` performs a shallow clone because the second argument has no effect; the function name and call form are unchanged.
downstream_effect: The downstream project (istex-api-faker) builds its route table with `urls.push(_.clone(urlTmp, true))` and then mutates `urlTmp.query` in place; after the upgrade all twelve records share one `query` object, request matching by `_.isEqual` fails, and requests return 404. The two failures are `expected 404 to equal 200` with frames only in `test/basic.spec.js` and superagent; lodash, `clone` and `urls-to-fake.js` never appear.
reference_fix: The reference fix changes the twelve `_.clone(urlTmp, true)` calls in `urls-to-fake.js` to `_.cloneDeep(urlTmp)`.
documented_in: The lodash Changelog v4.0.0 (https://github.com/lodash/lodash/wiki/Changelog), section Compatibility Warnings, states that the `isDeep` params were removed from `_.clone` and `_.flatten`, and the Split out methods list mentions `_.clone` and `_.cloneDeep`. Tier 2: prose only; the new form is derived from the v3 `_.clone` and v4 `_.cloneDeep` jsdoc.
failing_tests: test/basic.spec.js:24 :: Istex API faker should return a JSON when /document/?q=* is requested
test/basic.spec.js:45 :: Istex API faker should ignore _1424268118509 querystring parameters comming from jquery-jsonp
